title: Mobility Equipment Field Service Standard — Drive-Base Handling Allowance
content:
# Drive-Base Handling Allowance — Mobility Equipment

**Standard.** A drive-base handling allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty drive motor or gearbox replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the chair's loaner and home-assessment records: 2 units when no loaner chair has been delivered for the chair and two or more in-home accessibility assessments are recorded on it, 1 unit when no loaner chair has been delivered for it and exactly one in-home accessibility assessment is recorded, and nothing in any other case.

## Decision table

| Loaner chair delivered for the chair | In-home accessibility assessments on the chair | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| no | two or more | 2 units |
| no | exactly one | 1 unit |
| no | none | none |
| yes | any number | none |

The loaner deliveries are deliveries in the chair's service history whose purpose is a loaner chair; every recorded in-home accessibility assessment visit on the chair counts.

## Hypothetical cases

- Two home assessments on file, no loaner delivered: 2 units.
- Three home assessments on file, a loaner chair delivered during the repair: none.
